title: A Busy Morning
text:
Anna wakes up at seven o'clock. She runs to the bathroom and brushes her teeth. Then she eats bread and drinks milk in the kitchen. She reads the news on her phone.

At eight, Anna walks to school. She opens her bag and takes out her notebook. She writes notes during the first lesson. After school, she jumps on the bus to go home.

paragraph_translations: Anna se despierta a las siete en punto. Corre al baño y se cepilla los dientes. Luego come pan y bebe leche en la cocina. Lee las noticias en su teléfono.
A las ocho, Anna camina a la escuela. Abre su mochila y saca su cuaderno. Toma notas durante la primera clase. Después de la escuela, sube al autobús para ir a casa.
